note: Well-known opening traps, keyed by the exact move sequence that sets them. `line` is SAN from the start; the very next ply belongs to `victim`, and playing one of `losing` walks into it. Matching is prefix-only, so a transposition into the same position is not detected.

traps.name: Scholar's Mate
traps.note: The queen and bishop both hit f7. Nf6 defends the queen and forgets the mate.

traps.name: Damiano Defence
traps.note: After Nxe5 fxe5 Qh5+ the king is dragged out and the rook falls.

traps.name: Petrov's early Nxe4
traps.note: Qe2 pins on the e-file; if the knight steps back to f6 then Nc6+ is a discovered check winning the queen.

traps.name: Fried Liver Attack
traps.line: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nf6 Ng5 d5 exd5
traps.note: Recapturing on d5 invites Nxf7, dragging the king to e6 in front of the whole army.

traps.name: Blackburne Shilling Gambit
traps.line: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 Nd4
traps.note: Qg5 forks the knight and g2. The free pawn on e5 costs a piece at least.

traps.name: Legal's Mate
traps.line: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bc4 d6 Nc3 Bg4 h3 Bh5 Nxe5
traps.note: Taking the queen allows Bxf7+ Ke7 Nd5#. Giving the pawn back with dxe5 keeps the game.

traps.name: Fishing Pole Trap
traps.line: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 Nf6 O-O Ng4 h3 h5
traps.note: Taking the knight opens the h-file for Black's rook and queen. Leave it alone and play in the centre.

traps.name: Noah's Ark Trap
traps.line: e4 e5 Nf3 Nc6 Bb5 a6 Ba4 d6 d4 b5 Bb3 Nxd4 Nxd4 exd4
traps.note: Qxd4 c5 drives the queen away and the pawns roll up with c4, catching the bishop on b3.

traps.name: Stafford Gambit
traps.line: e4 e5 Nf3 Nf6 Nxe5 Nc6 Nxc6 dxc6 d3 Bc5
traps.note: Be2 is the move that takes the sting out: it covers g4 and unpins in advance.

traps.name: Elephant Trap
traps.line: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 Nf6 Bg5 Nbd7 cxd5 exd5
traps.note: The d5 pawn only looks loose: Nxd5 Nxd5 Bxd8 Bb4+ wins a piece back with interest.

traps.name: Cambridge Springs Trap
traps.line: d4 d5 c4 e6 Nc3 Nf6 Bg5 Nbd7 e3 c6 Nf3 Qa5
traps.note: The queen on a5 pins the knight on c3. Ne4 exploits it; Nd2 defuses it first.

traps.name: Lasker Trap
traps.line: d4 d5 c4 e5 dxe5 d4
traps.note: e3 runs into Bb4+ Bd2 dxe3 with exf2+ and an underpromotion on g1.

traps.name: Kieninger Trap
traps.line: d4 Nf6 c4 e5 dxe5 Ng4 Bf4 Nc6 Nf3 Bb4+
traps.note: Nbd2 allows Qe7 a3 Ngxe5 axb4 Nd3 mate. Blocking with Nc3 instead keeps everything defended.

traps.name: Englund Gambit Trap
traps.line: d4 e5 dxe5 Nc6 Nf3 Qe7
traps.note: Defending the pawn with Bf4 walks into Qb4+ and a raid on b2. Develop and give the pawn back.

traps.name: Caro-Kann Smothered Mate
traps.line: e4 c6 d4 d5 Nc3 dxe4 Nxe4 Nd7 Qe2
traps.note: The natural developing move blocks the king's escape: Nd6 is mate on the spot.
